cases.mechanism_detail: The XDP-SVA in TAF1 intron 32 forms G-quadruplex structures that impede RNA Pol II, producing truncated transcripts containing intron 32 (i32) and less full-length TAF1; the KRAB-ZNF ZNF91 binds and represses the SVA, and ZNF91 knockout in patient iPSC-derived cells worsens i32 retention/failed splicing, while SVA excision rescues it.
cases.quote: In XDP, the pathogenic XDP-SVA insertion forms G4 structures that obstruct RNA Pol progression, resulting in the production of truncated transcripts containing intron 32 (i32).
